name: Boiler air preheater
description: Heat exchanger that transfers heat from outgoing flue gas to incoming combustion air. Regenerative (rotary) designs use a rotating matrix or baskets; recuperative designs use tubular or plate elements. B&W supplies air heaters and notes the cold-end metal temperature is generally approximated from the average gas and air temperatures.

specifications.basis: B&W: general assumption is that cold-end metal temperature is approximately the average of the gas and air inlet temperatures (qualitative, no numeric value on the read page)
specifications.value: average of gas and air inlet temperatures
